about: What a character keeps of its creation beside the look: Race, SubRace, BodyType, BodyShape, Name and the point-buy abilities. A respec can only be started on a character that carries it. Script Extender: CharacterCreationStats.

evidence.says: Script Extender declares eoc::CharacterCreationStatsComponent::Race at +0x0 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Data.h:168): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.

Script Extender declares eoc::CharacterCreationStatsComponent::SubRace at +0x10 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Data.h:168): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.

Script Extender declares eoc::CharacterCreationStatsComponent::PointBuyAbilities at +0x40 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Data.h:168): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.

Script Extender declares eoc::CharacterCreationStatsComponent::field_5C at +0x5C (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Data.h:168): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types; the computed offset equals the one in its earlier name. Not checked against the game's code.
the game's executable keeps this type name among its ECS type names (gatekit symbols types), as struct eoc::CharacterCreationStatsComponent
the handler of the Osiris call StartRespec (bg3_dx11.exe+0x36ACE20) answers false for a character without this component

on Astarion in Basic_Level_A: Race and SubRace are ids, BodyType 0, BodyShape 0, Name is the display name in the game's language, the byte at +0x5C reads 3 - the same value as Identity in the definition of a change-appearance session on him

questions.ask: whether the byte at +0x5C (Script Extender: field_5C) is the identity: compare it with the Identity component on characters of other identities

survey.from: Script Extender's declarations (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Data.h:168, kind component), by gatekit symbols se-layouts on 2026-11-14
survey.names: Every name here is Script Extender's author's (his headers), not the game's own: they are kept because they are what the extender's Lua answers to and what bg3_verify compares, and every field carries the rung `extender` - the extender's name for the field at that offset, which nobody has checked against the game's code. A name is raised from `extender` only with evidence from the code, by `gatekit names set`.
